definition_source: paper/论文初稿_KF预测补偿_v3.tex, eq:total_social_input and eq:social_factorization
reference_heading: common checkpoint heading immediately before occlusion, frozen for every remaining-count branch
population_axis: S0=mean_i S_i immediately after masking, before the first model update
strength_control: A0=mean_i sum_j w_ij, stored as initialTotalStrength
coherence_outcome: parent protocol: terminal mean of per-time min(GO,LO)
main_plot: all primary seed-condition points against S0, plus prespecified input bins and seed-cluster bootstrap intervals

bins.pooling: case-weighted within each input bin; all cases from each seed stay together in bootstrap

candidate_selection_note: kappa=1 restores the early definition; optional future positive nonconstant forms are compared as scalar descriptors with seed-grouped splits; A alone is a strength baseline
